definition: a drop of water or other liquid.
example: ಎಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ಬಿಂದು ಮಂಜು ಬಿದ್ದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A drop of dew had fallen on the leaf.

definition: one of the two pieces of stone discus of a hand-driven flour mill.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಅಡ್ಡಕಲ್ಲನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಬೇಗ ಬೇಗ ಬೀಸಿದಳು.
example_en: The grandmother quickly turned the lower millstone and ground the flour.

definition: to wind or gather (rope, a hose, etc.) into a circular or spiral form; to roll (an object) into cylindrical form.
example_en: He carefully wound the rope into a coil.

definition: an approximate estimation of the cost, expenditure, etc.
example_en: We prepared an approximate cost estimate for building the house.

definition: any of a large and widely distributed terrestrial or aquatic reptiles of Testudines order, having a toothless beak and a soft body encased in a tough shell into which the head, tail, and four legs may be withdrawn; a turtle; a tortoise.
example_en: The tortoise pulled its head into its shell.

definition: name of a particular game of boys.
example: ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಂಜೆ ತಿಳ್ಳಿ ಆಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The village children play tilli every evening.

definition: to swallow in morsel or morsels; to gulp.
example_en: The hungry boy quickly gulped the rice.

definition: an adjective modifying another adjective.
example_en: In grammar, an adverb (modifying adjective) modifies another adjective.

definition: to take and keep with the hands or arms or by other means; to grasp; to clutch; to seize; to hold.
example_en: He held the rope tightly.

definition: an order, system or manner that is opposed to the regular one; the state or quality of being perverse.
example_en: Everyone grew tired of his perverse behaviour.

definition: to make some connection, physical connection or relation.
example_en: The new road connected the two villages.

definition: a lock of hair left on the crown or sides of the head at tonsure.
example: ಪುರೋಹಿತರು ತೋನ್ಸೂರದ ಸಮಯ ತಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಶಿಖಂಡ ಉಳಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The priest left a lock of hair on the crown during the tonsure.

definition: a quantity that is ten times more than another quantity.
example: ಈ ವರ್ಷದ ಲಾಭ ಕಳೆದ ವರ್ಷದ ಪದಿರ್ಮಡಿಯಾಯಿತು.
example_en: This year's profit became ten times that of last year.

definition: the tree Eucalyptus marginata of Myrtaceae family, akin to Eucalyptus tree.
example_en: Eucalyptus trees had been planted along the side of the road.

definition: reputation based on one's good character, behaviour, compassion, clemency, empathy, etc.
example: ಆತನ ಔದಾರ್ಯದಿಂದ ಆ ಮನೆತನಕ್ಕೆ ದೊಡ್ಡಿಮೆ ಬಂದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That family gained a good reputation because of his generosity.

definition: a sheep reared for its flesh.
example_en: The farmer rears the sheep for its meat.

definition: an order given to kill (a person or persons).
example_en: The king issued an order for the traitor's execution.

definition: to make ready; to prepare.
example_en: The teacher prepared the lesson.

definition: good reputation; fame; renown.
example: ಆ ಕವಿಗೆ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ಲೋಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧಿ ಇದೆ.
example_en: That poet has fame in the world of literature.

definition: a group of houses in the country, larger than a hamlet and smaller than a city or town; a village.
example_en: They migrated from the village to the town.

definition: the knowledge based on the previous experience or knowledge.
example: ಹಿಂದಿನ ಘಟನೆಗಳಿಂದ ಬಂದ ಅನುಬೋಧ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The knowledge gained from previous experiences was useful to him.

definition: the colour of pure snow; white.
example_en: The white of the snow covered the mountain peak.

definition: a disease in which fistulas and ulcerous holes form in the private parts.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಲೂತಿ ರೋಗಕ್ಕೆ ಔಷಧಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: The doctor gave him medicine for the fistulous disease.

definition: a kind of sorghum grown in India.
example_en: The koḍamūka sorghum grows well even during drought.

definition: a tiger (Panthera tigris).
example_en: A tiger was hunting in the forest.

definition: clear; pure; limpid.
example_en: They drank the clear water on the hill.

definition: the plant Ipomoea paniculata ( = Batatas paniculata) of Convolvulaceae family.
example: ಕಾಡಿನ ಅಂಚಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕ್ರೋಷ್ಟ್ರೀ ಬಳ್ಳಿ ಹಬ್ಬಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The Ipomoea creeper had spread and grown at the edge of the forest.

definition: the tree Madhuca malabarica ( = Bassia malabarica) of Sapotaceae family.
example_en: Birds eat the fruits of the Madhuca malabarica tree.

definition: the act of breathing out; exhalation.

definition: the state, fact or quality of resembling; similarity; resemblance.
example: ಎರಡು ಕವಿತೆಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಒಂದು ಸೊಗಸಾದ ಉಪಮಾನ ಕಂಡುಬಂತು.

definition: three times the quantity, number, etc.
example: ಈ ಬೆಳೆಯ ಇಳುವರಿ ಹಿಂದಿನ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಮೂವಡಿ ಇದೆ.
example_en: This crop's yield is threefold compared to last year.

definition: going; moving; not stationary.
example_en: Those moving clouds were traveling across the sky.

definition: the shrub Melastoma malabathricum of Melastomataceae family; Indian rhododendron.
example: ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ತಪ್ಪಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದೊಡ್ಡನೆಕ್ಕರೆ ಪೊದೆಗಳು ದಟ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿವೆ.

definition: amounting to or measuring one and a quarter.

definition: (pl.) all the things.

definition: collection of revenues, taxes due to the government.
example_en: Revenue collection work was going on at the village office.

definition: a professional fool or clown, esp. at a royal court; a jester.

definition: an indicating, displaying.
example_en: A display of fear appeared on his face.

definition: (math.) a table containing the exponents expressing the powers to which a base must be raised in order to produce a series of number; a logarithmic table.

definition: a wooden or metal bar to fasten the door or window panel; a latch.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಮನೆಯ ಕಿಟಕಿಗೆ ಲಾಳವುಂಡಿಗೆ ಇನ್ನೂ ಇತ್ತು.

definition: the left; left side.
example_en: He was lying on his left side.

definition: to include, contain (within oneself, one's sphere, range, jurisdiction, etc.).
example_en: This treatise contains all the sciences.

definition: to shine brightly; to be brilliantly luminous.
example_en: The lightning shone brightly in the sky.

definition: muddy water.
example_en: After the rain, the lake was full of muddy water.

definition: a kind of game, played with playing cards.
example: ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರು ಸಂಜೆ ಬೇಸ್ತು ಆಡುತ್ತಾ ಕಾಲ ಕಳೆದರು.
example_en: The friends spent the evening playing that card game.

definition: to contract, shrink oneself; to become wrinkled or withered; to shrivel.
example_en: His hands shrank from the cold.

definition: one's wok, occupation or profession; business; affair.
example_en: His occupation is the cloth business.

definition: the act of commending; a praising.

definition: to strike the palms of the hands together, as in applauding or approving.

definition: any hardened remains or imprints of plant or animal life of some previous geologic period, preserved in the earth's crust, including petrified wood, resin, etc.

definition: an interjection expressing abhorrence.

definition: to receive; to accept.
example_en: He gladly accepted the prize.

definition: the jasmine flower.
example_en: She had adorned her hair with a jasmine flower.

definition: to come or go against to meet and welcome respectfully.
example_en: The villagers went to meet and welcome the king respectfully.

definition: the outer side of the arm.
example: ಗಾಯದ ಗುರುತು ಅವನ ಹೊಱಕೆಯ್ಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇನ್ನೂ ಇತ್ತು.

definition: agreeable or friendly relations; harmony.

definition: the time of day from noon to evening; afternoon.

definition: a man who drinks alcoholic liquor as a matter of habit or to excess; a habitual drunkard.

definition: to cause to throb, pulsate.
example_en: That news made his heart throb.

definition: the quality of being ingenious; cleverness; ingenuity.
example_en: His cleverness quickly resolved the problem.

definition: (dial.) the tongs used by goldsmiths, blacksmiths, etc.
example_en: The goldsmith held the hot gold with the tongs.

definition: any of the games of chance played for money or some other stakes; a playing of gambling.
example_en: Gambling had been banned in the village.

definition: water saturated or strongly impregnated with salt; brine; salt water.
example_en: The sea's salt water is not fit for drinking.

definition: a seal which is usedmark documents officially; a signet.
example_en: The officer's seal was stamped on the document.

definition: to produce a vocal sound.
example_en: That machine produced a strange vocal sound.

definition: a man known well for his merits or virtues.
example_en: All the villagers called him a man renowned for his virtues.

definition: a hallucinated woman.
example_en: That hallucinated woman was wandering alone in the street.

definition: a very young child; a baby; an infant.
example_en: That infant was smiling in the cradle.

definition: a dashing of the blowing wind.
example_en: The dashing of the wind through the trees continued all night.

definition: a preamble - a) an introduction, esp. one to a constitution, statute, etc., stating the reasons for it and its purpose; b) an introductory fact, event, etc.; preliminary.
example: ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಅವತಾರಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಲೇಖಕ ತನ್ನ ಉದ್ದೇಶ ವಿವರಿಸಿದ್ದಾನೆ.

definition: the act of going out; departure; exit.
example_en: He made his exit and left the assembly.

definition: the quality of being shrewd, quick, brisk; acumen; smartness.
example_en: One who lacks shrewdness in business suffers loss.

definition: the science, art or occupation concerned with cultivating land, raising crops, and feeding, breeding, and raising livestock; agriculture; farming.
example_en: He left farming and came to the town.

definition: lean; thin; emaciated.

definition: to make a donation of; to present a grant, gift or contribution to.

definition: the celistial river Gange; the Gangā river.

definition: absence of heat; lack of warmth; cold; coldness.
example_en: In winter, the morning cold was severe.

definition: the condition of boiling violently with bubbling sound.

definition: an extent of level land; plain.
example_en: A vast plain stretched outside the town.

definition: to reprimand strongly.
example_en: The father reprimanded his son who had done wrong.

definition: packed food.
example_en: They packed food for the journey.

definition: to go to another region or country.
example_en: He went to another country for work.

definition: the red-sun.
example_en: People are afraid to go outside in the red sun.

definition: any of a number of semitropical or tropical grasses (family Poaceae) often resembling trees, with perennial, jointed stems that are woody, hard, springy, and hollow; bamboo.

definition: a thing to play with; a child's toy; a play-thing.

definition: a hearing attentively; the act of listening carefully.

definition: sexual union; copulation.

definition: a man who records sounds with the help of a tape recorder; a recorder.

definition: to construct, fabricate or hem the edge.
example_en: Hem the edge of the cloth.

definition: a dirty person.
example_en: No one lets that dirty person come near.

definition: a variety of leech (of subclass Hirudinea).
example_en: In the forest, a variety of leech stuck to his leg.

definition: brightly; brilliantly; splendidly.
example_en: The jewelled crown shone splendidly.

definition: to show disinclination for physical exertion and escape from it.
example_en: Being lazy, he showed disinclination for work and escaped from it.

definition: a man who is hereditarily working as a slave.

definition: (phil.) the original nature from which the phenomenal world is created; the germ out of which matter of all apparent forms are evolved.

definition: a member of an army; a soldier.

definition: haste - a) rapidity of motion; b) rash or headlong action; c) undue eagerness to act.

definition: the plant, Vitis vinifera, a climber.

definition: a metal chain or fetters.

definition: the act, practice or quality of being hospitable; solicitous entertainment of guests.
example_en: The village people's hospitality was famous.

definition: (said of a serpent) having a raised hood.

definition: sounded or sounding.

definition: (dial.) name of a demi-goddess.

definition: a large, rectangular piece of cotton, linen, silk, etc., used on a bed or as a wrapper over the body; a sheet; bedspread.

definition: the state of the food being not digested by the body system; indigestion.

definition: a single hand.

example_en: In the Prashnopanishad, Pippalada answers the questions of those seeking knowledge of Brahman.

definition: a man who organises, brings in to being or makes (something) happen; an organiser.

definition: the plant Leucas lavandulaefolia ( = L. linifolia) of Lamiaceae family.

definition: the act of a person or animal that hunts (either as a sport or for living).

definition: the act of sneezing (as from irritation of the nasal mucuous membrane or from cold).

definition: immediately; instantly.

definition: the script of any foreign language.

definition: a male human being; a man.

definition: one who decorates or covers with designs, patterns, etc. raised above the surface; an embosser.

definition: short, loose trousers reaching partway to the knees; shorts.

definition: a dark-green variety of quartz spotted with red jasper, used as a semiprecious gem; heliotrope.

definition: the upper garment of woman, covering the shoulders, back and breasts; a blouse.

definition: the Fire-God, whose banner is smoke.

definition: the state of holding the neck upward; the act of holding so.

definition: to split lengthwise.

definition: a pile or accumulation of many things placed or thrown one on another; a heap.

definition: the last part of the day;the evening.

definition: the bliss, felicity of the final emancipation.

definition: the act or method of describing; that which is described; description.

definition: to protect or guard (someone, something) from danger, damage, destruction, etc.

definition: the authority, status of a leader, owner or proprietor.

definition: to attack in a forceful, violent, hostile or aggressive way.

definition: a bed or couch.

definition: an exploding; esp., a blowing up or bursting with a loud noise; detonation; explosion.

definition: to become familiar by custom, habit or use; to habituate oneself; to accustom oneself to.

definition: the condition of being difficult, tiresome; difficulty.

definition: to shine brightly.

definition: the act of moving, walking, etc.

definition: ground or crushed with the teeth; chewed; masticated.

definition: completely; fully.

definition: to close or shut oneself.

definition: a quarrelsome woman.

definition: the quality of having loose texture.
example: ಈ ಬಟ್ಟೆಯ ಜಾಬಾಳ ಗುಣ ಬೇಗ ಹರಿಯುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The loose texture of this cloth makes it tear quickly.

definition: air taken into the lungs and then let out; breath.

definition: anything seized by force or robbery; plunder.

definition: a woman worthy of being lauded; a praiseworthy woman.

definition: to become numb physically.

definition: a group of people constituting one side in a contest or competition or a group of people working together in a coordinated effort; a team.
example_en: Our team won the match.

definition: the field, profession of a writer, author.
example_en: She became famous in the field of literature.

definition: the sun.
example_en: The sun rose in the eastern direction.

definition: a female snake.
example: ಭುಜಂಗಿ ಮರದ ಕೊಂಬೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಹರಿದಾಡುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The female snake was slowly gliding on the tree branch.

example_en: The falseness in his words was clearly visible.

definition: the act of following another's instructions, suggestions or will; obedience.

example_en: The two sides of that coin were adorned with different images.

definition: a man who talks fluently; an eloquent speaker.
example_en: That eloquent speaker impressed everyone at the meeting.

definition: a neatly moulded, compact brick; a table-mould brick; a wire-cut brink.
example: ಮೇಜಿಟ್ಟಿಗೆಗಳನ್ನು ಒಂದರ ಮೇಲೊಂದು ಜೋಡಿಸಿ ಗೋಡೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿದರು.
example_en: They stacked the neatly moulded bricks one on top of another and built the wall.

definition: a miserable condition; wretchedness.
example: ಬರಗಾಲದ ನಂತರ ಆ ಊರು ವಿಪರೀತಗತಿಗೆ ಸಿಲುಕಿತು.
example_en: After the famine, that village fell into a miserable condition.

definition: a channel in which water is running.
example_en: Water flows to the field through the running channel.

definition: to become stiff and brittle from drying.
example_en: The twig dried in the sun and became stiff and brittle.

definition: a man who makes basket, mats, etc. using bamboo splits.
example: ಆ ವೈಣ ಬಿದಿರಿನಿಂದ ಸುಂದರವಾದ ಬುಟ್ಟಿಗಳನ್ನು ಹೆಣೆದನು.
example_en: That bamboo craftsman wove beautiful baskets from bamboo.

definition: (myth.) the mighty male buffalo, the vehicle of Yama, the Death-God and God of Righteousness.
example_en: The mighty buffalo, the vehicle of Yama, was powerful.

example_en: There is a description of sexual sport in that poem.

definition: converted into a shapeless mass or turned into a sphere.

example_en: When heated, that metal took on a shapeless, mass-like form.

definition: the act of cleaning.

example_en: Cleaning work took place in the temple before the worship.

definition: a taking of fruits only for food.
example_en: In the evening she came after having a light fruit meal.

definition: a ceasing or stopping.
example: ಔಷಧಿ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಂಡ ನಂತರ ನೋವಿಗೆ ಉಪರತಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿತು.

example: ಆ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಲೆ ಪದ್ಮಬೀಜದ ಮರಗಳು ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತವೆ.
example_en: Juniper trees grow on that hill.

definition: a physical fight among many or between two group of, persons.
example_en: A physical fight took place between the two groups.

definition: the surface-water in a water-body.
example_en: The surface-water of the pond had warmed from the sun.

definition: not published or not being published; not made public.
example_en: That news still remains unpublished.

definition: comfortable; refreshing; pleasing; enjoyable.
example_en: The cool breeze was very refreshing.

definition: a woman who gives, bestows; a giver; a bestower.

example_en: She is unmatched in charity, a true giver.

definition: a lower court of law.
example_en: That case was heard in the munsiff court.

definition: a living in a city.
example_en: He prefers city-living to village life.

definition: a separating or being separated; separation.
example_en: The separation of property took place between the brothers.

example_en: He studied the Vedas at the religious educational institution.

definition: never existing before; appearing, thought of, developed, made, produced, etc. for the first time; new.
example_en: Everyone liked this new idea.

definition: a stopping place for buses for the transfer of freight or passengers; a bus station.
example_en: The passengers were waiting for the bus at the bus station.

definition: a feeling of intentness, concern or curiosity about something; interest.
example_en: The teacher showed concern for the students.

definition: the cloud that brings rain.
example_en: A rain-bearing dark cloud covered the sky.

definition: a kind of tree.
example_en: A daramba tree had grown on the outskirts of the village.

definition: an instrument for measuring height by means of changes in atmospheric pressure or by means of the time taken for radio wave from an aircraft to be reflected back; an altimeter.
example_en: The aircraft's altimeter showed the correct altitude.

definition: a sloping ledge in a wall etc. where the thickness of the part above is diminished; an offset in the wall of a well or at the foot of a wall of a building.
example_en: An offset ledge was seen in the wall of the well.

example_en: They dried the washed piece of cloth in the sun.

example_en: He inclined his mind towards music.

example_en: His thoughts became focused towards a single goal.

example_en: I did not expect this kind of behaviour.

example_en: Boiling water was seething in the vessel on the stove.

definition: one who heralds the time for religious prayer in a mosque.
example_en: The muezzin gave the call to prayer from the mosque.

definition: the property of some substances that conducting electricity or heat through them, but partially or inefficiently.
example: ಈ ವಸ್ತುವಿನ ಅರೆವಾಹಕತೆ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಉಪಕರಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: This substance's semi-conducting property is useful in electrical devices.

definition: to be defiled; to become polluted.
example_en: The food touched by the dirty water became defiled.

definition: an armour for the breast; a chest-guard.
example_en: The soldier fastened the chest-guard onto himself.

definition: a kind of poetical conversation, in the form of a song, sung by a group of persons hailing the excellence of women over men (as a sport).
example_en: At the festival, the women sang the nagesi song and celebrated.

definition: to be forbidden, prohibited; banned from being used.
example_en: Hunting must be prohibited in that area.

definition: a jealous, envious man.
example: ಸಮತ್ಸರಮಾನಿಸ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಇತರರ ಸುಖ ಕಂಡು ಕುದಿಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: The jealous, envious man always burns seeing others' happiness.

definition: (hist.) a unit of an Mughal army.
example: ಮೊಗಲ್ ಸೈನ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ದಖೀಲಿ ಎಂಬ ಒಂದು ಘಟಕವಿತ್ತು.

definition: the reaping of crops; harvest.

example_en: This time's harvest is greater than last year's.

definition: set ablaze.
example_en: The hut was set ablaze by fire.

definition: the act of hearing, listening.

definition: to strip or deprive of skin; to peel; to skin.

example_en: He accepted that job because of his friend's assurance, relying on him.

definition: having a corpulent body; bulky; lubberly.
example: ಠೊಣೆಯ ದೇಹದ ಆ ಮನುಷ್ಯ ನಡೆಯಲು ತುಂಬಾ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿದ್ದನು.

definition: a thin, long line.

definition: the plant Rourea santaloides of Connaraceae family; naval wort; (?).

definition: the profession, service of or befitting a military man.

definition: a crown set with a diamond or diamonds.

definition: a hard try; an attempt; an endeavour; effort.

definition: causing , confering or being good; gracious; propitious; auspicious.
